mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MEMBER WHERE STATUS='PENDING'

SELECT TO_CHAR(C.CREATED_AT, 'MM-DD') AS createdAt , SM.USER_NAME AS studentName , CC.CATEGORY_NAME AS categoryName , CL.CLASS_NAME AS className , CM.USER_NAME AS counselorName , TRUNC(SYSDATE - C.CREATED_AT) AS elapsedDays , C.CATEGORY_NO AS categoryNo
FROM COUNSEL_RESERVATION C JOIN STUDENT_DETAIL SD ON C.STUDENT_NO = SD.STUDENT_NO JOIN MEMBER SM ON SD.USER_NO = SM.USER_NO JOIN COUNSEL_CATEGORY CC ON C.CATEGORY_NO = CC.CATEGORY_NO JOIN CLASS CL ON SM.CLASS_NO = CL.CLASS_NO JOIN COUNSELOR_PROFILE CP ON C.COUNSEL_NO = CP.COUNSEL_NO JOIN MEMBER CM ON CP.USER_NO = CM.USER_NO
WHERE C.RESERVATION_STATUS = 'APPLIED' AND SM.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND CM.STATUS = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY C.CREATED_AT ASC

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM COUNSEL_RESERVATION C JOIN STUDENT_DETAIL SD ON C.STUDENT_NO = SD.STUDENT_NO JOIN COUNSELOR_PROFILE CP ON C.COUNSEL_NO = CP.COUNSEL_NO
WHERE C.RESERVATION_STATUS = 'APPLIED' AND SD.STUDENT_STATUS = 'ATTENDING' AND CP.STATUS = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT TO_CHAR(C.CONSULT_DATE,'HH24:MI') AS reservationTime , CC.CATEGORY_NAME AS categoryName , SM.USER_NAME AS studentName , CM.USER_NAME AS counselorName , C.CATEGORY_NO AS categoryNo
FROM COUNSEL_RESERVATION C JOIN COUNSEL_CATEGORY CC ON C.CATEGORY_NO = CC.CATEGORY_NO JOIN STUDENT_DETAIL SD ON C.STUDENT_NO = SD.STUDENT_NO JOIN MEMBER SM ON SD.USER_NO = SM.USER_NO JOIN COUNSELOR_PROFILE CP ON C.COUNSEL_NO = CP.COUNSEL_NO JOIN MEMBER CM ON CP.USER_NO = CM.USER_NO
WHERE C.RESERVATION_STATUS = 'RESERVED' AND SM.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND CM.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND C.CREATED_AT >= TRUNC(SYSDATE) AND C.CREATED_AT < TRUNC(SYSDATE) + 1
ORDER BY C.CREATED_AT ASC

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM COUNSEL_RESERVATION C JOIN STUDENT_DETAIL SD ON C.STUDENT_NO = SD.STUDENT_NO JOIN COUNSELOR_PROFILE CP ON C.COUNSEL_NO = CP.COUNSEL_NO WHERE C.RESERVATION_STATUS = 'RESERVED' AND SD.STUDENT_STATUS = 'ATTENDING' AND CP.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND C.CREATED_AT >= TRUNC(SYSDATE) AND C.CREATED_AT < TRUNC(SYSDATE) + 1

SELECT C.CATEGORY_NO AS categoryNo , CC.CATEGORY_NAME AS categoryName
, COUNT(CASE WHEN C.CREATED_AT >= TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM') THEN 1 END) AS currCount
, COUNT(CASE WHEN C.CREATED_AT >= ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM'), -1) AND C.CREATED_AT < TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM') THEN 1 END) AS prevCount
, ROUND( COUNT(CASE WHEN C.CREATED_AT >= TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM') THEN 1 END) / NULLIF( SUM( COUNT(CASE WHEN C.CREATED_AT >= TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM')THEN 1 END) ) OVER(), 0 )* 100 , 1) AS rate
FROM COUNSEL_RESERVATION C LEFT JOIN COUNSEL_CATEGORY CC ON C.CATEGORY_NO = CC.CATEGORY_NO GROUP BY C.CATEGORY_NO, CC.CATEGORY_NAME ORDER BY C.CATEGORY_NO
SELECT CATEGORY_NO AS categoryNo , CATEGORY_NAME AS categoryName FROM COUNSEL_CATEGORY

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM COUNSELOR_INVITE CI LEFT JOIN MEMBER CM ON CM.USER_NO = CI.USER_NO WHERE CM.ROLE_CODE = 'COUNSELOR'
AND ((CI.INVITE_STATUS = 'PENDING' AND INVITE_EXPIRED_AT > SYSDATE) OR (CI.INVITE_STATUS = 'USED' AND CM.STATUS = 'ACTIVE'))
AND CI.INVITE_STATUS = 'USED' AND CM.STATUS = 'INACTIVE'
AND ( NVL(CM.USER_NAME, CI.INVITE_NAME) LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR NVL(CM.EMAIL, CI.INVITE_EMAIL) LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR CM.PHONE LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' )

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT ROWNUM AS RNUM, P.* FROM ( SELECT CI.USER_NO AS userNo , CI.INVITE_NO AS inviteNo , NVL(CM.USER_NAME, CI.INVITE_NAME) AS userName , NVL(CM.EMAIL, CI.INVITE_EMAIL) AS email , CL.CLASS_NAME AS className , CM.CLASS_NO AS classNo , NVL(CM.STATUS, CI.INVITE_STATUS) AS status , CC.CATEGORY_NAME AS categoryName , CP.CATEGORY_NO AS categoryNo
FROM COUNSELOR_INVITE CI LEFT JOIN MEMBER CM ON CM.USER_NO = CI.USER_NO LEFT JOIN COUNSELOR_PROFILE CP ON CM.USER_NO = CP.USER_NO LEFT JOIN CLASS CL ON CL.CLASS_NO = CM.CLASS_NO LEFT JOIN COUNSEL_CATEGORY CC ON CC.CATEGORY_NO = CP.CATEGORY_NO WHERE CM.ROLE_CODE = 'COUNSELOR'
AND ((CI.INVITE_STATUS = 'PENDING' AND INVITE_EXPIRED_AT > SYSDATE) OR (CI.INVITE_STATUS = 'USED' AND CM.STATUS = 'ACTIVE'))
AND CI.INVITE_STATUS = 'USED' AND CM.STATUS = 'INACTIVE'
AND ( NVL(CM.USER_NAME, CI.INVITE_NAME) LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR NVL(CM.EMAIL, CI.INVITE_EMAIL) LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR CM.PHONE LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' )
ORDER BY CI.USER_NO NULLS FIRST , CASE WHEN CL.CLASS_NAME IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END , CM.USER_NAME )P ) WHERE RNUM BETWEEN #{pageRequest.startRow} AND #{pageRequest.endRow}

SELECT CL.CLASS_NO AS classNo , CL.CLASS_NAME AS className FROM CLASS CL WHERE CL.STATUS = 'Y' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM MEMBER M WHERE M.ROLE_CODE = 'COUNSELOR' AND M.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND M.CLASS_NO = CL.CLASS_NO ) ORDER BY CL.CLASS_NO

SELECT M.USER_NO AS userNo , M.USER_ID AS userId , CP.PROFILE_IMG_PATH AS imgPath , M.STATUS AS status , NVL(CL.CLASS_NAME, '미지정') AS className , M.USER_NAME AS userName , M.PHONE AS phone , M.EMAIL AS email , CC.CATEGORY_NAME AS categoryName , ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MEMBER SM WHERE SM.CLASS_NO = M.CLASS_NO AND SM.ROLE_CODE = 'STUDENT' ) AS studentCount
FROM MEMBER M LEFT JOIN COUNSELOR_PROFILE CP ON M.USER_NO = CP.USER_NO LEFT JOIN CLASS CL ON M.CLASS_NO = CL.CLASS_NO LEFT JOIN COUNSEL_CATEGORY CC ON CC.CATEGORY_NO = CP.CATEGORY_NO WHERE M.USER_NO = #{value}

, STATUS = 'ACTIVE'

UPDATE COUNSELOR_INVITE SET INVITE_STATUS = 'CANCELED' WHERE INVITE_NO = #{value} AND INVITE_STATUS = 'PENDING'
UPDATE STUDENT_DETAIL SET COUNSELOR_NO = NULL WHERE COUNSELOR_NO = (SELECT COUNSEL_NO FROM COUNSELOR_PROFILE WHERE USER_NO = #{value})

UPDATE STUDENT_DETAIL SD SET COUNSELOR_NO = (SELECT COUNSEL_NO FROM COUNSELOR_PROFILE WHERE USER_NO = #{userNo}) WHERE SD.USER_NO IN (SELECT M.USER_NO FROM MEMBER M WHERE ROLE_CODE = 'STUDENT' AND CLASS_NO = #{changeNo})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM DUAL WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM MEMBER WHERE EMAIL = #{value}) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM COUNSELOR_INVITE WHERE INVITE_EMAIL = #{value} AND INVITE_STATUS = 'PENDING' AND INVITE_EXPIRED_AT > SYSDATE)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO COUNSELOR_INVITE (INVITE_NO, INVITE_NAME, INVITE_EMAIL, INVITE_TOKEN) VALUES(SEQ_INVITE_NO.NEXTVAL, #{counselorName}, #{email}, #{inviteToken})
mapper.select: SELECT CI.INVITE_NO AS inviteNo , CI.INVITE_NAME AS inviteName , CI.INVITE_EMAIL AS inviteEmail , CI.INVITE_SENT_AT AS inviteSentAt , CASE WHEN CI.INVITE_STATUS = 'PENDING' AND INVITE_EXPIRED_AT < SYSDATE THEN 'EXPIRED' WHEN CI.INVITE_STATUS = 'USED' THEN M.STATUS ELSE CI.INVITE_STATUS END AS inviteStatus , CI.USER_NO AS userNo FROM COUNSELOR_INVITE CI LEFT JOIN MEMBER M ON (CI.USER_NO = M.USER_NO) WHERE INVITE_SENT_AT > SYSDATE -2 ORDER BY INVITE_SENT_AT DESC
